in_hebrew.name: Halda
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Halda הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word ‘halos’, meaning ‘ruler’ or ‘noblewoman’. In the New Testament, Halda may be related to the name Hadassah, which means ‘myrtle branch’, a symbol of strength and dedication.

in_greek.name: Halda
